data.title: 德尔塔 · 仓储木箱的特级肉干
data.description: 四越地下仓储库房内。德尔塔盘腿蹲坐在两米高的大木箱顶端，两腮塞得鼓鼓囊囊像只大松鼠，两手抓着比手臂还粗的熏烤肉干大口撕咬，警惕的兽瞳在昏暗库房中骨碌碌地转悠护食。
data.location: cavernous wooden supply warehouse filled with towering cargo crates and rope pulleys
data.action: crouched squatting on top of a tall wooden crate, happily tearing into a massive smoked meat skewer with both hands, puffed cheeks
data.lighting: warm dust-mote sunlight beaming down from high rafters onto weathered wooden boxes
data.mood: hilarious beast-girl appetite, territorial cuteness, untamed feral charm
data.promptProse: Delta in denim overalls squats on a warehouse wooden crate, chewing voraciously on a huge smoked meat bone with puffed cheeks.
data.animaCaption: Perched on wooden supply crates, warm sunbeams highlight her puffed cheeks as she munches happily.
